title: Left at the second corner
setting: A Saturday morning outside their building. Satou-san, the elderly neighbour, has to go to a new hospital by the station next week and is worried about getting lost: last week he turned at the wrong corner and ended up an hour late. Yuki offers to go with him, and he reminds her of the day she got lost at that same station when she was five.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: a, satou-san, ohayou gozaimasu. dou shita n desu ka? komatta kao shitemasu ne.
lines.ja: あ、佐藤さん、おはようございます。どうしたんですか？困った顔してますね。
lines.kana: あ、さとうさん、おはようございます。どうしたんですか？こまったかおしてますね。
lines.english: Oh, Satou-san, good morning. Is something wrong? You look worried.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: aa, yuki-san, ohayou gozaimasu. raishuu, eki no chikaku no atarashii byouin ni iku n desu ga, michi ni mayowanai ka shinpai de.
lines.ja: ああ、ユキさん、おはようございます。来週、駅の近くの新しい病院に行くんですが、道に迷わないか心配で。
lines.kana: ああ、ゆきさん、おはようございます。らいしゅう、えきのちかくのあたらしいびょういんにいくんですが、みちにまよわないかしんぱいで。
lines.english: Ah, Yuki-san, good morning. I'm going to the new hospital near the station next week, and I'm worried I'll get lost.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: aa, ano byouin nara kantan desu yo. eki o dete, futatsume no kado o hidari ni magaru dake desu.
lines.ja: ああ、あの病院なら簡単ですよ。駅を出て、二つ目の角を左に曲がるだけです。
lines.kana: ああ、あのびょういんならかんたんですよ。えきをでて、ふたつめのかどをひだりにまがるだけです。
lines.english: Oh, that hospital's easy. You come out of the station and just turn left at the second corner.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sore ga desu ne, senshuu ichido itta n desu ga, michi o machigaete shimatte.
lines.ja: それがですね、先週一度行ったんですが、道を間違えてしまって。
lines.kana: それがですね、せんしゅういちどいったんですが、みちをまちがえてしまって。
lines.english: Well, you see, I went once last week, but I went the wrong way.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: e, doko de machigaeta n desu ka?
lines.ja: え、どこで間違えたんですか？
lines.kana: え、どこでまちがえたんですか？
lines.english: Oh no, where did you go wrong?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: hitotsume no kado o, hidari ni magatte shimatta n desu. futatsume da to wa shiranakute.
lines.ja: 一つ目の角を、左に曲がってしまったんです。二つ目だとは知らなくて。
lines.kana: ひとつめのかどを、ひだりにまがってしまったんです。ふたつめだとはしらなくて。
lines.english: I turned left at the first corner. I didn't know it was the second one.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: aa, eki no mae wa kado ga ippai arimasu kara ne. sore wa michi ni mayoimasu yo ne.
lines.ja: ああ、駅の前は角がいっぱいありますからね。それは道に迷いますよね。
lines.kana: ああ、えきのまえはかどがいっぱいありますからね。それはみちにまよいますよね。
lines.english: Ah, there are so many corners outside the station. No wonder you got lost.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sore kara wa, doko ni iru no ka mo wakaranakute. nanajuugo ni mo natte, maigo ni naru to wa omoimasen deshita yo.
lines.ja: それからは、どこにいるのかもわからなくて。七十五にもなって、迷子になるとは思いませんでしたよ。
lines.kana: それからは、どこにいるのかもわからなくて。ななじゅうごにもなって、まいごになるとはおもいませんでしたよ。
lines.english: After that I didn't even know where I was. I never thought I'd end up a lost child at seventy-five.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: jaa, raishuu wa watashi mo issho ni ikimasu yo. futari nara, michi ni mayoimasen kara.
lines.ja: じゃあ、来週は私も一緒に行きますよ。二人なら、道に迷いませんから。
lines.kana: じゃあ、らいしゅうはわたしもいっしょにいきますよ。ふたりなら、みちにまよいませんから。
lines.english: Then I'll come with you next week. With two of us, we won't get lost.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: arigatou gozaimasu. demo yuki-san, oboete imasu ka? mukashi, ano eki de maigo ni natta koto.
lines.ja: ありがとうございます。でもユキさん、覚えていますか？昔、あの駅で迷子になったこと。
lines.kana: ありがとうございます。でもゆきさん、おぼえていますか？むかし、あのえきでまいごになったこと。
lines.english: Thank you. But Yuki-san, do you remember? The time you got lost at that station, years ago.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: e, watashi ga maigo ni natta n desu ka? oboete nai desu.
lines.ja: え、私が迷子になったんですか？覚えてないです。
lines.kana: え、わたしがまいごになったんですか？おぼえてないです。
lines.english: What, I got lost? I don't remember that.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: gosai gurai deshita ka ne. eki no mae de hitori de, okaasan o sagashite imashita yo.
lines.ja: 五歳ぐらいでしたかね。駅の前で一人で、お母さんを探していましたよ。
lines.kana: ごさいぐらいでしたかね。えきのまえでひとりで、おかあさんをさがしていましたよ。
lines.english: You must have been about five. You were outside the station all alone, looking for your mother.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: sore de, dou natta n desu ka?
lines.ja: それで、どうなったんですか？
lines.kana: それで、どうなったんですか？

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: watashi ga uchi made okutta n desu ga, yuki-san ga kotchi! hidari ni magaru no! tte itte kikanakute.
lines.ja: 私がうちまで送ったんですが、ユキさんが「こっち！左に曲がるの！」って言って聞かなくて。
lines.kana: わたしがうちまでおくったんですが、ゆきさんが「こっち！ひだりにまがるの！」っていってきかなくて。
lines.english: I walked you home, but you kept insisting, 'This way! We turn left!' and wouldn't listen.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: e, demo uchi wa, eki kara migi desu yo ne?
lines.ja: え、でもうちは、駅から右ですよね？
lines.kana: え、でもうちは、えきからみぎですよね？
lines.english: Wait, but home is to the right from the station, isn't it?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: ee. futari de michi o machigaete, ichijikan mo kakarimashita yo.
lines.ja: ええ。二人で道を間違えて、一時間もかかりましたよ。
lines.kana: ええ。ふたりでみちをまちがえて、いちじかんもかかりましたよ。
lines.english: Yes. We went the wrong way together, and it took us a whole hour.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: sumimasen deshita! raishuu wa chanto, futatsume no kado o hidari ni magarimasu kara.
lines.ja: すみませんでした！来週はちゃんと、二つ目の角を左に曲がりますから。
lines.kana: すみませんでした！らいしゅうはちゃんと、ふたつめのかどをひだりにまがりますから。
lines.english: I'm so sorry! Next week I'll turn left at the second corner, properly. I promise.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: hai. kondo wa, michi o machigaenaide kudasai ne.
lines.ja: はい。今度は、道を間違えないでくださいね。
lines.kana: はい。こんどは、みちをまちがえないでくださいね。
lines.english: Yes. This time, please don't take us the wrong way.

choices.english: Satou-san got lost on his way to the hospital last week, so Yuki offers to drive him there, and he tells her how he once got lost as a boy.
Satou-san is worried about getting lost on the way to a new hospital. Yuki offers to go with him, and he reminds her of the time she got lost as a little girl and led them both the wrong way.
Yuki got lost on her way to the new hospital last week, and Satou-san explains that you turn left at the second corner.

questions.explanation: Line 2: Satou-san is going to the new hospital next week and is worried he'll get lost (michi ni mayowanai ka shinpai de). Line 9: Yuki says she'll go with him. In lines 10-16 he reminds her that she got lost at the station when she was about five (maigo ni natta), and that when he walked her home she insisted on turning left, so the two of them went the wrong way. A gets the memory backwards: Yuki was the lost child, not Satou-san, and she offers to go with him (issho ni ikimasu), not to drive. C swaps their roles: Satou-san is the one who went wrong last week (lines 4-6), and Yuki gives the directions (line 3).

questions.english: Tanaka-san is giving you a lift home after work. Near your place he asks: "Which way next?" Ask him to turn left at the next corner.
questions.answer: Ask politely for a left turn with hidari ni magaru, the side marked with ni: tsugi no kado o hidari ni magatte kudasai.

modelAnswers.romaji: tsugi no kado o hidari ni magatte kudasai.
modelAnswers.ja: 次の角を左に曲がってください。
modelAnswers.english: Please turn left at the next corner.

modelAnswers.romaji: a, tsugi, hidari ni magatte moraemasu ka?
modelAnswers.ja: あ、次、左に曲がってもらえますか？
modelAnswers.english: Oh, could you turn left next?

questions.explanation: Turning is magaru and the side takes ni: Yuki's directions are futatsume no kado o hidari ni magaru (line 3), and little Yuki's insistence was hidari ni magaru no! (line 14). Not hidari ni mawaru: mawaru is spinning or going round something. If you name the corner, it takes o (or de): tsugi no kado o hidari ni. In a taxi the verb often drops: tsugi, hidari de onegai shimasu.

questions.english: How does Yuki first explain the way to the hospital?
questions.ja: ユキさんは病院までの道を、何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: ゆきさんはびょういんまでのみちを、なんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: yuki-san wa byouin made no michi o, nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: You just turn left at the second corner.
choices.romaji: futatsume no kado o hidari ni magaru dake desu.

choices.english: You just turn left into the second corner.
choices.romaji: futatsume no kado ni hidari ni magaru dake desu.

choices.english: You just go round to the left at the second corner.
choices.romaji: futatsume no kado o hidari ni mawaru dake desu.

questions.explanation: Line 3: eki o dete, futatsume no kado o hidari ni magaru dake desu, and she promises the same in line 17. The corner takes o because you go round it, and the side takes ni, so one sentence holds both: kado o hidari ni magaru. B puts ni on the corner, as English 'turn into the corner' suggests, but ni already marks the side, so kado ni hidari ni sounds broken. C uses mawaru, which is spinning or going round something; a turn at a corner with a side named is magaru.

questions.english: You're walking to meet friends in a part of town you don't know, and you have no idea where you are. Kenta calls: "Hello? Where are you? Everyone's already here." Tell him you've got lost.
questions.ja: もしもし、今どこ？もうみんな来てるよ。
questions.kana: もしもし、いまどこ？もうみんなきてるよ。
questions.romaji: moshimoshi, ima doko? mou minna kiteru yo.
questions.answer: Say you're lost with michi ni mayou, usually as mayotta or mayotchatta: gomen, michi ni mayotchatta.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, michi ni mayotchatta. chotto okureru.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、道に迷っちゃった。ちょっと遅れる。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, I've got lost. I'll be a bit late.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, ima michi ni mayottete, doko ni iru ka wakannai.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、今道に迷ってて、どこにいるかわかんない。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, I'm lost right now. I don't know where I am.

questions.explanation: Being lost, with no idea where you are, is michi ni mayou: Satou-san worries michi ni mayowanai ka (line 2), and Yuki says sore wa michi ni mayoimasu yo ne (line 7). Not michi o nakusu: nakusu is for losing things like keys. michi machigaeta would only say you took a wrong road, and maigo ni natta would make you sound like a child who has lost their parents.

questions.english: Satou-san says he went the wrong way last week. What had he done?
questions.ja: 佐藤さんは先週、どこで道を間違えましたか？
questions.kana: さとうさんはせんしゅう、どこでみちをまちがえましたか？
questions.romaji: satou-san wa senshuu, doko de michi o machigaemashita ka?

choices.english: He got off the train at the wrong station.
He turned right at the second corner instead of left.
He turned left at the first corner instead of the second.

questions.explanation: Line 4: michi o machigaete shimatte, and line 6 says where: hitotsume no kado o, hidari ni magatte shimatta n desu. futatsume da to wa shiranakute. michi o machigaeru is taking the wrong road on a route; what came after, not knowing where he was (line 8), is michi ni mayou. A: his mistake came after he left the station; a wrong stop would be eki o machigaeta. B: he did turn left, as he should have; it was the corner he got wrong.

questions.english: You and Sora are at a packed fireworks festival. He says: "Wow, so many people. I'm just popping to the toilet." Tell him, half joking, not to get lost.
questions.ja: うわ、すごい人。ちょっとトイレ行ってくるね。
questions.kana: うわ、すごいひと。ちょっとトイレいってくるね。
questions.romaji: uwa, sugoi hito. chotto toire itte kuru ne.
questions.answer: Tell him not to wander off with maigo ni naru in the -naide form: maigo ni naranaide ne.

modelAnswers.romaji: un. hito ooi kara, maigo ni naranaide ne.
modelAnswers.ja: うん。人多いから、迷子にならないでね。
modelAnswers.english: Okay. There are loads of people, so don't get lost.

modelAnswers.romaji: wakatta. maigo ni nattara, denwa shite ne.
modelAnswers.ja: わかった。迷子になったら、電話してね。
modelAnswers.english: Got it. If you get lost, give me a call.

questions.explanation: maigo is a noun, 'lost child', so you become one: maigo ni naru, never maigo suru. It is for getting separated in a crowd, like five-year-old Yuki outside the station looking for her mother (lines 10-12), and adults use it of themselves half-jokingly, as Satou-san does in line 8. Being lost on the road with nobody to be separated from is michi ni mayou.

newWords.english: the first, the second (counting along: futatsume no kado = the second corner)
two people; the two of us (futari de = together)
